# ASCII Ocean → 0/1 on black

Patched copy of `dsh-ascii-ocean@0.3.0`'s `lib/client.js`, the decoration that swims
behind the conv

`dsh-ascii-ocean@0.3.0`'s `lib/client.js`, the decoration that swims
behind the conversation column.
## The look

Every cell of the school is a **near-black tile** carrying **one binary digit**, so the
fish is draw
n by the characters themselves — a shark-shaped cloud of `0` and `1`.

- Cell tile: `mix(bodyColour, black, 0.86)` — about `#161719` where lit, `#0d0d0f` where
shaded. It

keeps a trace of the body colour so the silhouette still exists, without
becoming a filled plate.
-

Digit: 7×9 bitmap, **one-pixel strokes**, colour = the cell's shading
(`#535e6c` … `#c2c7d0`), so th

e lit flank glows and the back sinks into the black.
- `digitRate: 1` — every cell gets a digit; the

eye stays a solid dot.
- Fins use the same glyphs at 0.55 alpha so there is no second visual langua

ge.
- `heroOpacity: 1` (the black tiles are faint on their own), `idleOpacity: 0.06`.
## Palette

Sampled from a screenshot of the running plugin (`tools/cluster-shot.py`): a muted
steel blue, b − r
≈ 16, never grey and never vivid.
| | sampled | this build |

| page background | `#0e0e0d` | `#0a0a0b` |
| body dark | `#383c44` / `#3f424b` | `#535e6c` |
| body
hark skin base | — | `#828c9d` |
## Species

`shark` by default (sizes 1 / 0.72 / 0.86 — the original `classicHalfWidth`, small
pectoral fins and
needle tail). `dolphin` is still selectable under ⚙.
## ⚠ A full restart is required for changes to appear

The host reads the client module when it boots and keeps serving that copy, so a page
refresh shows

the old code no matter what is on disk. Quit DeepSeek Harness from the
tray and reopen it. The tell:
cells no longer contain `S X t %` letters.
## Knobs (⚙ in the corner)
| Slider | Default | Effect |

| 首屏不透明度 | 1 | layer opacity on the New Session hero |
| 会话内不透明度 | 0.06 | same, behind an active tra

nscript |
| 数字密度 | 1 | share of cells carrying a digit; 0 = empty black tiles |
| 格子大小 | 0 (auto) |

cell size 9–20 px; the digit scales with the cell |
| 点阵密度 / 网格强度 | 0.11 / 0.03 | background stars a

nd grid |
| 鲨鱼颜色 | `#828c9d` | skin base; the digit shading derives from it |
## Re-apply after a reinstall
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Copies `client.js` over the installed package (backing up the current file first), then
runs `verify
-client.mjs`. `pwsh` is not installed here, so use `powershell`.
## Verify
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Against the real module with a stubbed canvas: zero `fillText`, tiles on the grid and
near-black, a

digit on >90% of body cells, all glyphs well formed 7×9 (12 or 24 lit
blocks) with 1 px strokes, gly

ph colours blue, `digitRate: 0` → no glyphs, opacity
override honoured.

`tools/` holds the offline preview pipeline: `dump-frame.mjs` + `paint-frame.py`
(rasterise a frame)

, `shape-sheet.mjs` + `paint-sheet.py` (silhouettes),
`variant-grid.mjs` + `paint-grid.py` (proporti

on variants), `cluster-shot.py` +
`sample-shot.py` (palette sampling).
## Revert

`~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/.backup-ascii-ocean-*/pristine-lib/client.js` is the untouched
published fi
le; copy it back, then restart the app.
